properties.description: The Active column has too many vertically stacked sections: Waiting, In progress, Queued and Backlog, with further New, Later and Acknowledged groups. Headers and split panes consume too much space and leave cramped lists. Reconsider the layout and grouping so the board is enjoyable to browse and manage, including at narrower widths. Preserve the meaning of task states and attention groups; review the proposed presentation before implementing it.
properties.title: Rework the Activity board Active column layout
